Class RouteArguments

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.RouteArguments
@Internal public final class RouteArguments extends Object
The checks of the arguments of the routes declared in code, shared by the route builders, the route assembly and the route declarations.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • standardMethod

      public static HttpMethod standardMethod(@Nullable HttpMethod httpMethod, String byName)
      A standard HTTP method of a route: HttpMethod.CUSTOM stands for any custom method, which a route declares by its name.
      Parameters:
      httpMethod - The HTTP method
      byName - How to declare the route by the name of the method, for the message
      Returns:
      The HTTP method
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if it is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if it is HttpMethod.CUSTOM

      The name

    • port

      public static int port(int port)
      The port of a handler route or of a group of handler routes: a port the server can listen on. Unlike @Controller(port = ...), which ignores a negative port, and with 0 opens a listener on a random port that the route cannot know, it is rejected.
      Parameters:
      port - The port
      Returns:
      The port
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if it is not between 1 and 65535

    • port

      public static int port(String port, @Nullable PropertyPlaceholderResolver placeholderResolver)
      The port of a handler route or of a group of handler routes given as a string, like @Controller(port = "${my.admin.port}"): a number, or an expression with property placeholders, with defaults, e.g. ${my.admin.port:8081}, resolved with the placeholder resolver of the environment like the port of a controller, then checked like port(int).
      Parameters:
      port - The port or the expression
      placeholderResolver - The placeholder resolver of the environment, or null if there is none
      Returns:
      The port
      Throws:
      ConfigurationException - if a placeholder cannot be resolved
      IllegalArgumentException - if the port is not a number between 1 and 65535, or has a placeholder and there is no resolver
